rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when a passenger or traveller goes aboard a boat or ship.

example.english: Before we embark, remember to buy the ferry tickets at the pier.
example.traditional: 我哋上船之前，記得喺碼頭買定船飛。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 soeng5 syun4 zi1 cin4 gei3 dak1 hai2 maa5 tau4 maai5 ding6 syun4 fei1

rows.note: Use this when putting or moving cargo or an object aboard a boat or ship.

example.english: The workers need to embark the goods box by box before the ship leaves.
example.traditional: 工人要將啲貨一箱箱搬上船，趕喺開船之前完成。
example.jyutping: gung1 jan4 jiu3 zoeng1 di1 fo3 jat1 soeng1 soeng1 bun1 soeng6 syun4 gon2 hai2 hoi1 syun4 zi1 cin4 jyun4 sing4
